review: The hymn is the Lamb's praise: 1:1–4 is Ps 119:11 with Ps 84:3 (נִכְסְפָה וְגַם־כָּלְתָה) and 1 John 3:2, 2:1–4 is Rev 5:6,9 with 1 Cor 2:7–8, 3:1–4 is Ps 103:3 with Ps 32:1, and 4:1–4 is 1 Cor 15:20 with 1 Cor 15:57.

The refrain כָּבוֹד לַשֶּׂה הַהוּא closes every line-pair in stanzas 2–4 and closes stanza 1, exactly as the print repeats مَجْدًا لِذٰلِكَ الْحَمَل; the payload repeats it verbatim rather than varying it.

1:2 נַפְשִׁי כָּלְתָה — the Arabic يَا لَشَوْقِي لِشَخْصِهِ is an exclamation of longing; the Hebrew uses the psalm's verb כָּלָה (Ps 84:3), because Hebrew expresses this longing as the soul fainting and not as a wish.
